bibliographic.title: boydoll
bibliographic.author: jams
bibliographic.description:
a very quick and simple empty spaces microfic for the neo-twiny jam! wish i could have made it a bit more elaborate but focused on a different project this month.

empty spaces is a transfem focused style of fiction, that focuses on themes of trauma, agency, personhood, with character archetypes of dolls, witches, moths, angels, mech pilots etc. it was big on twitter a few years back in the form of microfics, which is why this one thought it would be suitable for a <500 word IF jam.

i. i. i am a person who uses first person pronouns lol. sometimes we get a little doll-brained.
